name: Exp_ColorBBCandles
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBBCandles custom indicator, which uses Bollinger Band deviation levels to classify candle colors. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward bias (value > 5) and sell positions when it signals a downward bias (value < 5), while closing all positions when a flat/neutral signal (value == 5) is detected.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBBCandles自定义指标进行交易，该指标利用布林带偏差水平对K线颜色进行分类。当指标值大于5时开多单，小于5时开空单，等于5时判定为盘整并平掉所有持仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于布林带偏差水平的多层分类，通过ColorBBCandles指标将K线分为上涨、下跌和盘整三种状态。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的值从前一根K线大于5且当前K线值小于6时开多单；当值从前一根K线小于5且当前K线值大于4时开空单。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及当指标值等于5时判断为盘整并平掉所有持仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的函数实现，支持按比例分配或固定手数两种模式。策略采用多周期架构，指标可在不同于图表的时间周期上运行，默认使用H4周期。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on multi-level classification of Bollinger Band deviation levels, using the ColorBBCandles indicator to categorize candles into bullish, bearish, and flat states. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when indicator buffer 4's previous value exceeds 5 and the current value is below 6; a sell signal triggers when the previous value is below 5 and the current value exceeds 4. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus closing all positions when the indicator value equals 5 (flat/neutral market). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management relies on functions from the included TradeAlgorithms.mqh file, supporting both proportional allocation and fixed lot modes. The strategy uses a multi-timeframe architecture where the indicator can operate on a different timeframe than the chart, defaulting to H4.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易份额或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Trade fraction or fixed lot; negative value = lots

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格滑点偏差点数
parameters.description_en: Max price slippage deviation in points

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 用于指标计算的价格常量

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用布林带多层偏差分类，能较好地区分趋势和盘整市场状态
支持按存款比例或固定手数两种仓位管理方式，灵活性较高
提供买卖开仓和平仓的独立开关，便于灵活控制交易方向
采用新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复交易
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Uses multi-level Bollinger Band deviation classification, effectively distinguishing between trending and flat market states
Supports both deposit-proportional and fixed lot position sizing, offering good flexibility
Provides independent toggles for buy/sell opening and closing, allowing flexible directional control
Implements new bar detection to prevent repeated trading within the same bar
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 信号判断逻辑依赖硬编码的阈值（5、4、6），缺乏自适应机制，不同品种可能需要重新调参
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh文件，核心交易逻辑不在本文件中，难以独立审查完整风险
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值偏大，可能在某些品种上导致过大风险敞口
缺乏点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在流动性差或点差大的时段可能产生不利成交
指标值判断条件（Value[1]>5且Value[0]<6）存在逻辑边界模糊，4-6之间的信号可能不稳定
cons_en: Signal logic relies on hardcoded thresholds (5, 4, 6) without adaptive mechanisms, requiring re-tuning for different instruments
Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh file, making it hard to independently audit the complete risk profile
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large, potentially creating excessive risk exposure on some instruments
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially executing unfavorable trades during low-liquidity or high-spread periods
Indicator value boundary conditions (Value[1]>5 and Value[0]<6) have ambiguous logic; signals in the 4-6 range may be unstable
improvements: 将硬编码的信号阈值（4、5、6）改为可配置的输入参数，提高策略的适应性和可调性
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差和低流动性时段入场
加入持仓检查和重复下单保护，防止在网络延迟或异常情况下产生多余持仓
improvements_en: Make hardcoded signal thresholds (4, 5, 6) configurable input parameters to improve strategy adaptability and tunability
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid entering during high-spread and low-liquidity periods
Add position check and duplicate order protection to prevent excess positions from network latency or anomalies

risk_points: 信号阈值硬编码，不同市场条件下可能产生错误信号导致连续亏损
缺少点差过滤，在高点差时段可能以不利价格成交
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh，其内部实现未经审查可能存在风险漏洞
止损止盈默认值较大，在波动性较低的品种上可能承受不必要的风险
risk_points_en: Hardcoded signal thresholds may produce false signals under varying market conditions, leading to consecutive losses
No spread filter may result in unfavorable execution during high-spread periods
Dependency on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh with unaudited implementation may contain risk vulnerabilities
Large default SL/TP values may expose unnecessary risk on low-volatility instruments
